summary: Iteration-3 full test: added /app/backend/tests/test_iter3_features.py (13 tests: weekly-plan persistence/validation, vision streaming for both modes with real bread JPEG+PNG base64, announcement title validation). Full backend suite = 40/40 passed. Frontend (mobile 390x844) verified: 4-tab bottom nav (mikilab/maestro/foto/sa-tutto), Maestro hub tools exactly [aggiungi, settimana, pianifica, forno] with NO 'Calcola gradi', Piano settimanale end-to-end (7 day cards, add items, dropdown lists only the 3 existing recipes, default g/pz by recipe name 800/400, doses recompute on pieces & g/pz change and on recipe switch, save -> persists across nav-away and full reload), Photo Diagnosi (hidden file input accept=image/*, preview, streaming AI analysis in Italian for both difetti and ingredienti, result cleared on mode switch), Stoccarda announcement delete AlertDialog (cancel keeps, confirm deletes), plus regressions: recipe duplicate + scale (scale creates a new recipe, original untouched), production-plan save, oven profile CRUD + phase timer (20:00 -> 19:57 -> reset), AI text chat streaming. DB restored to baseline (3 mikilab recipes, 0 personal, 0 oven profiles, 2 seeded announcements, no saved weekly/production plan).

minor.issue: No server-side validation that recipe_id refers to an existing recipe or that day is one of lun..dom; arbitrary values are accepted (frontend UI is safe because the dropdown only lists existing recipes, and stale items render 'Ricetta non piu disponibile'). Consider validating day enum + recipe existence.

Invalid/garbage image_base64 returns 200 with SSE '[Errore nell'analisi dell'immagine. Riprova.]' instead of a 4xx; acceptable for SSE but the client cannot distinguish a real error (no error toast shown, error text is streamed into the result panel).

issues: AI output is Markdown but rendered raw in a whitespace-pre-wrap div: '# ', '**bold**', emoji headings and Markdown tables ('| Ingrediente | Note |') are shown as literal characters. Consider react-markdown for photo-result and chat bubbles.
During the initial load the 'Aggiungi' buttons are disabled (recipes not yet fetched) with no loading indicator, so it briefly looks like the 'no recipes' state; a skeleton/spinner would be clearer.

action_items: Optional: render Markdown in photo-result (and chat) instead of raw text
Optional: validate weekly-plan day enum / recipe existence server-side
Optional: surface a real error state (toast) when vision streaming returns the error sentinel
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoDiagnosi.analyze() does not check res.ok before res.body.getReader(); a 4xx/5xx JSON error would be streamed into the result panel as raw text.
WeeklyPlan item ids are generated with Date.now()+random on the client; two items added in the same millisecond could collide (low risk but ids are used as React keys and testids).
seed_data_creation: Temporary only: TEST_UI_Annuncio announcement, TEST_Forno/TEST_Forno2 oven profiles, duplicated+scaled Altamura recipes, weekly/production plan docs - all deleted/reset after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suites: tests/backend_test.py, tests/test_new_features.py, tests/test_iter3_features.py (run with `python -m pytest tests/ -v` from /app/backend; pytest.ini uses -n 2 loadscope). Vision tests download a real bread JPEG from Unsplash to /tmp/bread.jpg; a resized copy for UI upload is at /app/.screenshots/bread_test.jpg. Not covered: the 'no recipes at all' empty state of Piano settimanale (destructive - would require deleting all 3 seeded mikilab recipes); code path verified by review only.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found in this iteration's features; the only observations are cosmetic (raw Markdown output) and defensive-validation gaps listed above.
